title: WHOOP Battery Pack Not Charging the Strap
shortDescription: Strap LED stays off when battery pack is slid on.
fullDescription: The WHOOP 4.0 wireless battery pack should produce a slow blue pulse on the strap when seated. Sweat or sunscreen residue between the contacts is the leading cause of failed charging, followed by a dead battery pack itself.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse strap and battery pack contacts with fresh water and dry thoroughly.

fixSteps.title: Charge pack
fixSteps.instruction: Charge the battery pack to full (solid blue) before sliding onto strap.

whenToCallPro: Contact WHOOP membership support for warranty replacement if cleaning and a known-good pack do not work.

faq.q: Can I charge in the shower?
faq.a: WHOOP says no — battery pack is not waterproof, only the strap is.

title: WHOOP App Shows No Recent Data
shortDescription: Recovery, strain, and sleep blank in app.
fullDescription: The strap caches up to 3 days of data and offloads via Bluetooth when the app opens. If sync stalls, the dashboard goes blank. Causes include a failed Bluetooth pair, app permissions, or strap firmware mid-update.

fixSteps.title: Force sync
fixSteps.instruction: Pull down on the WHOOP app home screen to trigger a manual sync.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: In Settings > Strap > Forget Strap, then re-add via Bluetooth.

whenToCallPro: Contact membership support if the strap won't pair after multiple attempts — hardware fault possible.

faq.q: How long does the strap cache data?

title: WHOOP Heart Rate Reads Wildly High or Low
shortDescription: Cardio strain numbers feel implausibly high during normal activity.
fullDescription: WHOOP uses a 5-LED PPG sensor that requires a snug fit and clean optical window. Loose fit, hairy wrists or dirty sensor windows cause cadence-locking artifacts where step rate is mistaken for HR.

fixSteps.title: Tighten strap
fixSteps.instruction: Position WHOOP 1-2 inches above the wrist bone with snug (not painful) fit.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the optical window with damp cloth and dry.

faq.a: Yes — for lifting and HIIT, bicep position is more reliable.

title: WHOOP Strap LED Stuck or Unresponsive
shortDescription: Strap does not respond to touch or fail to wake.
fullDescription: The WHOOP strap can hang during a firmware update or after a deep discharge. A hard reset is performed by holding a freshly charged battery pack on for 30 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Hard reset
fixSteps.instruction: Slide a fully charged battery pack on and hold for 30 seconds; remove and re-attach.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Force the WHOOP app to re-pair after reset.

whenToCallPro: Contact WHOOP support if reset doesn't recover the strap — RMA replacement is included with active membership.

faq.a: Cached data may be lost if the strap won't sync before reset — usually the last few hours.

title: WHOOP Did Not Record Sleep
shortDescription: Morning shows no sleep stages or recovery score.
fullDescription: WHOOP auto-detects sleep when motion is low and HR drops. Naps under 1 hour, daytime sleep, or strap removed at night cause missed detection. Sleep can be added manually.

fixSteps.title: Manual log
fixSteps.instruction: Tap Sleep tab > Edit Sleep and adjust start/end times manually.

fixSteps.title: Charge before bed
fixSteps.instruction: Top up to at least 50% before sleep to avoid overnight cutoff.

faq.q: Will manual logging affect recovery score?
faq.a: Yes — recovery is recalculated from the new sleep window.

title: WHOOP Strap Slip-Through Clip Broken
shortDescription: Hook detaches from strap during use.
fullDescription: The WHOOP SuperKnit hook can fatigue with constant pulling. Replacement hooks ship free under membership for the first year. Always pinch the hook gently rather than pulling on the loop.

fixSteps.title: Replace band
fixSteps.instruction: Order replacement SuperKnit through your WHOOP membership account.

fixSteps.title: Adjust technique
fixSteps.instruction: Open the hook by pinching, not pulling, to extend life.

faq.a: First band is included; replacements are free during first year of membership.

title: WHOOP App Cannot Find or Pair Strap
shortDescription: App search times out during pairing.
fullDescription: Pairing requires Bluetooth, location services, and a charged battery on both phone and strap. Some Android devices block low-energy Bluetooth scans without location permission granted to the WHOOP app.

fixSteps.title: Charge strap
fixSteps.instruction: Slide on a charged battery pack for 30+ minutes before retry.

fixSteps.title: Permissions
fixSteps.instruction: Grant Bluetooth and Location to WHOOP app in OS settings.

whenToCallPro: Contact membership support if pairing still fails after charge + permissions.

faq.q: Can I use one strap on two phones?
faq.a: Yes, but you must un-pair from the first phone before pairing the second.

title: WHOOP Causing Rash or Skin Irritation
shortDescription: Red marks or rash where strap contacts skin.
fullDescription: Most WHOOP rash issues are friction or trapped moisture, not allergic reaction. Loosening the band slightly, alternating wrists, and rinsing the strap regularly resolves nearly all cases.

fixSteps.title: Loosen and rotate
fixSteps.instruction: Slightly loosen the strap and switch wrists every few days.

fixSteps.title: Wash band
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse under warm water (no soap) and air-dry weekly.

whenToCallPro: See a dermatologist if rash persists more than a week after removing the strap.

faq.a: WHOOP states the SuperKnit is dermatologically tested but not formally hypoallergenic.

title: WHOOP Firmware Update Stalled
fullDescription: Firmware updates take 20-30 minutes and require the strap to be charging continuously and within Bluetooth range. Closing the app or moving away interrupts the update and may require a hard reset.

fixSteps.title: Restart update
fixSteps.instruction: Force close app, reopen, and let it resume. Keep phone awake and pack charged.

fixSteps.title: Hard reset
fixSteps.instruction: If still stuck, hold a fully charged battery pack on the strap for 30 seconds.

whenToCallPro: Contact WHOOP support if reset doesn't recover; the strap may be bricked.

faq.a: No — required updates block syncing until installed.

title: WHOOP Battery Drains in Less Than 2 Days
shortDescription: Strap loses charge well before the rated 4-5 days.
fullDescription: WHOOP batteries should last 4-5 days. Faster drain is usually caused by very high HR variability detection, intense workout logging, or a defective battery cell after multiple years of use.

fixSteps.title: Check battery health
fixSteps.instruction: View battery health in app under Strap settings.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Apply any pending firmware updates that include power management fixes.

whenToCallPro: Members on 12+ month subscription qualify for free strap upgrade if battery health is poor.

faq.a: Yes — below 32 F can cut runtime by 20-30%.
